recipes.name: Agentic Optimization
setup: Prepare Flask and native task dependencies plus an authenticated Codex CLI; use a private execution environment and explicit credential environment names.

profiles.description: AgenticOptimization native control plane and one bounded Codex worker search assignment

evaluation.description: AgenticOptimization native control plane and one bounded Codex worker search assignment Metrics and validity retain the native evaluator contract.

limitations: Source and fixture checks only; dependencies, paid model calls and native end-to-end execution are not verified. Native metrics are not canonical Arena task receipts.
Native task packages and Codex CLI/backend must be prepared; no dependency manifest or root license is supplied at this pin.
The driver creates a loopback-only control service and delegates assignment continuation/evaluation to native WorkerManager.
Native process completion does not establish canonical Arena fitness or a successful scientific result.
